children: Greenland Energy Pushes for Changes at Vision Marine Technologies with 9.66% Stake

Greenland Energy Company, an exploration-stage oil and gas company, disclosed a 9.66% stake in Vision Marine Technologies Inc. The company reported owning 69,281 shares as of November 25, 2026, after spending about $404,108 on open-market purchases. Greenland Energy says it wants board representation and may discuss whether Vision Marine should proceed with its previously announced proposed business combination.

Greenland Energy says it has engaged with Vision Marine’s board and management and intends to continue those talks about ways to increase shareholder value. It has also requested representation on the board.

The investor says it may discuss with Vision Marine management the possibility of not proceeding with the previously announced proposed business combination. Greenland Energy also says it may talk with other shareholders or third parties about the company and its investment.

Greenland Energy Company is incorporated in Texas and operates as an exploration-stage oil and gas company. It focuses on developing and advancing exploration activities in Greenland. For its Vision Marine investment, Greenland Energy says it bought shares because it viewed them as undervalued and an attractive opportunity.
